description: This file declares functions and a struct related to configuring and managing a 'libgit' configuration set, including allocation, freeing, file addition, value retrieval, and user agent string functions.

classes.name: libgit_config_set
classes.description: A struct representing a configuration set for libgit.

methods.name: libgit_configset_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and returns a new libgit configuration set.

methods.name: libgit_configset_free
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for a libgit configuration set.

methods.name: libgit_configset_add_file
methods.description: Adds a configuration file to the configuration set.

methods.name: libgit_configset_get_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer value associated with a key from the configuration set.

methods.name: libgit_configset_get_string
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with a key from the configuration set.

methods.name: libgit_user_agent_sanitized
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the user agent string.
